p: graves: The enemy for greediness will rifle your graves and lay you before those idols, who in your life you worshipped, to see if they can help you.
rather than life by all the: Because of the afflictions that they will feel through God's judgments.
fall: Is there no hope that they will return?
one turned to his course: They are full of hypocrisy, and everyone follows his own fantasy without any consideration.
judgment of the LORD: He accuses them in that they are more ignorant of God's judgments, than these birds are of their appointed seasons to discern the cold and heat.
the pen of the scribes is: The law does not profit you neither need it to have been written for all that you have learned by it.
wise men are ashamed: They who seem wise may be ashamed of their ignorance for all wisdom consists in God's word.
assemble yourselves: He speaks in the person of the people, who when the enemy comes will turn about to hide themselves and acknowledge that it is God's hand.
gall to drink: That is, has brought us into extreme affliction, and thus they will not attribute this plague to fortune, but to God's just judgment, Jer 9:15,23:15.
send serpents: God threatens to send the Babylonians among them who will utterly destroy them in such sort, as by no means they will escape.
comfort myself against sorrow: Read Jer 4:19.
have they provoked me to anger: Thus the Lord speaks.
harvest is past: The people wonder that they have for so long a time looked for comfort in vain.

in Gilead: Meaning,that no man's help or means could save them: for in Gilead was precious balm, Jer 46:11 or else deriding the vain confidence of the people, who looked to their priests for help, who would have been the physicians of their soul, and dwelt at Gilead, Ho 6:8.
